adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy`, the code fetches the record with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `host.destroy`. If the id is missing/invalid or the record was already deleted, `host` will be `nil` and `nil.destroy` will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500 instead of a 404/handled error. (Same nil-risk exists in `#update` passing a possibly-nil host into `save_host`.)
